name: Request router (echo)
short_descr: Config builder example: a request-routing tree saved as one JSON env value.
long_descr: Reference app for the config-builder wizard. It returns its ROUTER_CONFIG as JSON so the deployed config is easy to inspect; a real router would read the same value with the dictionary API.

params.name: ROUTER_CONFIG
params.descr: The routing tree as JSON (schemaVersion 1). Written by the config-builder wizard.
